mapper.insert: INSERT INTO baseline_remediation (result_id, host_id, rule_id, remediation_type, old_value, new_value, backup_data, execute_script, status, start_time, end_time, create_time) VALUES (#{resultId}, #{hostId}, #{ruleId}, #{remediationType}, #{oldValue}, #{newValue}, #{backupData}, #{executeScript}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, result_id, host_id, rule_id, remediation_type, old_value, new_value, backup_data, execute_script, status, start_time, end_time, create_time FROM baseline_remediation WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, result_id, host_id, rule_id, remediation_type, old_value, new_value, backup_data, execute_script, status, start_time, end_time, create_time FROM baseline_remediation WHERE result_id = #{resultId} AND status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY end_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, result_id, host_id, rule_id, remediation_type, old_value, new_value, backup_data, execute_script, status, start_time, end_time, create_time FROM baseline_remediation WHERE result_id = #{resultId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY start_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE baseline_remediation SET status = 'PENDING', start_time = COALESCE(start_time, NOW()) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE baseline_remediation SET status = #{status}, old_value = COALESCE(#{oldValue}, old_value), new_value = COALESCE(#{newValue}, new_value), backup_data = COALESCE(#{backupData}, backup_data), end_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE baseline_remediation SET status = 'ROLLBACK', end_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE baseline_remediation SET status = 'FAILED', end_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
